title: Waste of 10$
text: Waste of 10$. The Wal-Mart better homes and gardens smell way better than these! I paid 10$ and something for a box of barely scented wax. I'm not impressed at all. I would ask for my money back but I've burned two pieces trying to get some type of scent. These are not worth the money.
